---
title: "Setup"
---

Please complete these steps **before session 1**. They take about 20 minutes.

## 1 · Install R

Download and install the latest version of R for your computer from
<https://cran.r-project.org>.

## 2 · Install RStudio

Download and install **RStudio Desktop** (free) from
<https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/>.

## 3 · Install the course packages

Open RStudio, paste this into the **Console** and press Enter:

```r
install.packages(c("tidyverse", "gtsummary", "rio", "here"))
```

## 4 · Download the course data

Download [`patients.csv`](data/patients.csv) and save it in a folder called `course` in your
Documents.

::: {.callout-tip}
## Check it works
Run `library(tidyverse)` in the Console. If you see no red **Error** message, you are ready.
:::

::: {.callout-note}
## Can't install software on your computer?
Use [Posit Cloud](https://posit.cloud) in your web browser — free, nothing to install.
:::
